sources: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026, GDP current prices (NGDPD), DataMapper https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/NGDPD@WEO/RUS/ITA (screenshot 2026-11-13)

claims.claim: Russia is the largest country on Earth, about 17.1 million km2 (17,098,242 km2)
sources: CIA World Factbook, Russia, Area (public domain; page blocks automated access, figure via Factbook mirrors and Fondation Robert Schuman country sheet)

claims.claim: Russia has 11 time zones, Kaliningrad UTC+2 to Kamchatka UTC+12
sources: Russian federal law on the calculation of time (2011, amended 2014)

claims.claim: Italy would fit inside Russia about 57 times
IMF puts both economies under 3 trillion dollars in 2026
Population 2026: Russia about 143 million, Italy about 59 million
sources: IMF WEO Oct 2026, LP: RUS 143.394 m, ITA 58.879 m

claims.claim: GDP per person 2026: Russia about $20,000, Italy about $46,000
sources: IMF WEO Oct 2026, NGDPDPC: RUS 19,953, ITA 45,886

claims.claim: By purchasing power parity, Russia ranks fourth in the world (after China, the US, India)
sources: IMF WEO Oct 2026, PPPGDP 2026: CHN 44,555; USA 32,642; IND 19,193; RUS 7,543; JPN 7,324 bn intl $

claims.claim: Vladimir Putin has led Russia for more than 25 years as president or prime minister (acting president from 31 Dec 1999; prime minister 2008-2012)
Oil and gas: about 30% of federal budget revenue in 2024 (11.131 of 36.707 trillion roubles); 23% in 2025 according to Finance Minister Anton Siluanov (8.48 trillion roubles)
sources: Interfax, 21 Jan 2025, citing the Finance Ministry (2024 totals)
TASS: Oil and gas revenues of Russian budget down 23.8% in 2025 (ministry)
Reuters via oilandgas360: revenue falls 24% to lowest since 2020
Siluanov, quoted by TASS/Interfax: share 23% in 2025

claims.claim: Russia's military spending rose 5.9% in 2025 to an estimated $190 billion, 7.5% of GDP; the classified residual was about 79% of the National Defence budget
sources: SIPRI press release, 27 April 2026: Global military spending rise continues...
SIPRI Fact Sheet: Trends in World Military Expenditure, 2025
